transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hi Dr. Smith. Lately when I’m home alone, I end up eating way more food at once than I think most people would, and it keeps happening. I guess I just wanted to talk to someone about it.
After these episodes of eating a large amount of food, do you engage in any behaviors to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, excessive exercise, or fasting?

No, I don't do anything like that, like throwing up or trying to burn it off with exercise. Usually, I just feel really guilty and miserable afterward, so I end up just lying in my bed feeling heavy and gross.
Do you find that you feel this way or have these episodes of overeating even when you are not feeling particularly sad, hopeless, or lacking interest in things you usually enjoy?
I'm not entirely sure, I haven't really thought about it that way. It usually just happens when I'm bored or gaming in my room, rather than because I'm feeling really sad or hopeless beforehand.
Over the past three months, how many times per week on average would you say these episodes of eating a large amount of food occur?
For the past three or four months, it’s been happening at least once a week, and usually more often than that. It almost always happens late at night when I'm by myself in my room.
During these episodes, do you feel that you lose control over your eating, such as feeling like you cannot stop or are unable to control how much you are eating?

Yes, absolutely. It feels like something just clicks off in my brain, and even though I'm telling myself, "Dude, you don't need more," my hands just keep grabbing food. I can't seem to stop until everything in front of me is completely gone.
During these episodes, do you often eat much more rapidly than normal, or eat until you feel uncomfortably full?

Yeah, both of those happen. I eat incredibly fast, barely chewing and just shoveling food in between gaming rounds, so what should last an hour is gone in ten minutes. I also eat past the point of fullness until my stomach hurts and feels so tight that I have to lie back on my bed because I'm too stuffed to sit up comfortably.
